name: Food Warehouse retail block
observations: Broad red-brick two-storey/shallow-roof retail mass; multiple lower businesses share the visible frontage.
Very large red/orange Food Warehouse NOW OPEN sign spans part of upper wall.
Small rectangular upper windows and branded panels repeat along the block.
Lower shop bays include Oxfam, cardfactory and Savers, with light framed glazing and separate fascias.
Steps/ramps and dark railings occur along the footway; exact level changes need cross-view checking.
Open car-park/entrance area north of block is not another attached shop wall.
unknowns: Food Warehouse entrance/location within shared block is only partly visible; do not duplicate Oxfam/cardfactory/Savers as separate full upper buildings.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
